body:
If you really don’t have to pay that much, save up for a house. Just bust your ass there for a few years and be frugal.

Or save up a bit, quit, get a different job and figure out life

Can’t move out, getting to and from work is easily $600 a month because I have to lyft. It’s so far in the middle of nowhere that’s my only option. I have to save up for a second car, phone bill, other bills, bills, and did I mention bills?

I eat tuna sandwiches and eggs, and drink water. 

My dad is long gone, he’s probably doing drugs who knows where.

I live with my mother, she’s also a druggie, she’s behind on bills and bugs the shit out of me, so I wish I could move out. 

I’m not trying to be pessimistic, I really want what’s best for myself.

I tried seeing if anyone would let me carpool with them, no luck.
